_documentation.purpose: Settings schema and category/section metadata owned by video.
_documentation.consumer: extension/settings/controllers/ZentralSettingsCatalog.js reads schema/settings; Runtime filters availability, UI controllers render controls.
_documentation.contract: This object is data only. Missing descriptor hides owner settings; it does not start or unload the feature. Keep property/defaultValue and category IDs synchronized with preferences.json and extension/settings/layout.json.
